description: The documented probabilistic demand model represents household-appliance use and was applied to Sparanise, Italy. The authors compare simulated daily volumes and peaks with reservoir output. This resource is provided by Francesco Lombardi; Guglielmo Silvagni; Piero Sirini and coauthors. Coverage is city as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists JPG, PNG, XLS formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The Figshare deposit lists images and an XLS file. It supports a documented method; executable software was not confirmed. For simulation, it can support model-based scenario analysis. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
